item.title: The Air Force Just Received Its First T-7A Red Hawk
item.description: The T-7A Red Hawk will join the 12th Flying Training Wing’s 99th Flying Training Squadron, paving the way for future training and eventually replacing the aging T-38C Talon. The post The Air Force Just Received Its First T-7A Red Hawk appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The First Finnish F-35 Has Taken Flight
item.description: That first flight came almost four years to the day that the Finnish government announced it had selected the F-35 as the winner of its HX Fighter Program. The post The First Finnish F-35 Has Taken Flight appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The Legendary USS Intrepid Now Has a Digital Clone
item.description: A team of surveyors scanned every inch of the USS Intrepid to create a 15-terabyte digital model—aided by its closure to the public during the COVID-19 pandemic. The post The Legendary USS Intrepid Now Has a Digital Clone appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Inside the Space Force’s Push for Orbital Missile Killers
item.description: The development of these weapon systems has a clear goal: deter and, if necessary, defeat US adversaries in space, particularly China. The post Inside the Space Force’s Push for Orbital Missile Killers appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How the F-20 Tigershark’s Failure Changed the Aviation Business Forever
item.description: Northrop’s design methodology with the F-20 Tigershark—build a great fighter jet first and worry about sales later—was a catastrophic mistake. The post How the F-20 Tigershark’s Failure Changed the Aviation Business Forever appeared first on The National Interest.
